result.title: Seeing Beyond Names: Image-Grounded Concept Linking for Robust Vision-Language Recognition
result.summary: A zero-shot vision-language classifier is highly sensitive to the class names it receives. Even when images remain unchanged, replacing familiar labels with synonyms, abbreviations, or ontology terms can significantly alter predictions. We investigate this \emph{vocabulary shift} using a leakage-free evaluation protocol across Tiny ImageNet, ImageNet-R, ImageNet-A, and ImageNetV2. With CLIP ViT-B/16, alternative class names reduce top-1 accuracy by $14.8$--$17.6$ percentage points. To address this issue, we propose \emph{image-grounded concept linking}, a training-free method that maps class names to visual concepts and uses a reliability gate to improve predictions. The method outperforms a template ensemble across all four datasets, achieving a pooled gain of $1.8$ points. We further evaluate five vision-language backbones across four datasets. Our method improves performance in $16$ of $20$ backbone--dataset combinations, with no significantly negative results. It also reduces pooled negative log-likelihood across all five backbones. Stronger text linking and transductive refinement provide no consistent improvements, suggesting that accurate visual class-name linking remains the main challenge. A second CLIP ViT-B/16 seed confirms the improvement on ImageNetV2, but not on ImageNet-A.

AI.brief_summary: 论文研究零样本视觉语言分类器对类别名称措辞的敏感性（「词汇漂移」），在四个 ImageNet 变体上用无泄漏协议测得 CLIP ViT-B/16 换名后 top-1 下降 14.8–17.6 点，并提出免训练的「图像接地概念链接」加可靠性门控来缓解，在 20 个骨干–数据集组合中 16 个有提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 可靠性门控与「将标签映射到视觉概念」的机制，可供核查如何依据视觉证据可信度筛选与加权候选，可能对应 LVR 中的视觉证据筛选与是否真正使用视觉信息的判定；但其任务是分类而非 latent 推理，联系需较多迁移确认。
